title: A Novel Scalarized Scaffold Hopping Algorithm with Graph-Based Variational Autoencoder for Discovery of JAK1 Inhibitors.
summary: GraphGMVAE scaffold hopping from upadacitinib yielded seven synthesized JAK1 inhibitors from 25 prioritized candidates. In biochemical assays, separated Ten01/Ten02 had IC50 values of 5.0/16.8 nM; activity does not establish therapeutic efficacy.
ai_technology: GraphGMVAE graph variational autoencoder with message-passing encoders

evidence.tested: Seven synthesized compounds were tested in an ADP-Glo JAK1 kinase assay. Ten01 and Ten02 had IC50 values of 5.0 and 16.8 nM after chiral separation; the other isomeric mixtures ranged from 0.50 to 9.6 μM. The Ten01/Ten02 mixture had IC50 64 nM.
evidence.unknown: The assays establish biochemical JAK1 inhibition only. The campaign synthesized seven compounds from 25 prioritized molecules; some potency values followed chiral separation and other compounds were tested as isomeric mixtures.
evidence.ai_role: GraphGMVAE, a graph variational autoencoder with Gaussian-mixture latent space, generated scaffold-hopped molecules from upadacitinib; docking and CNN affinity scoring helped prioritize compounds for synthesis.

source_review.scope: Full PMC paper, including synthesis/assay methods, results and discussion.
